title: Love the measuring spoons most
text: Love the measuring spoons most. I love this set but definitely love the measuring spoons the most.

product_metadata.title: 20PCS Measuring Cups and Measuring Spoons Set, Food-Grade Stainless Steel Measure Cup Set for Cooking Baking Measurement, Including 7 Cups, 9 Spoons, Level, Magnetic Chart, Stackable Measuring Set
features: 【 Food Grade Stainless Steel 】 Measuring cups and spoons set is made of food-grade 18/8 stainless steel, 100% no toxic, rust-resistant, and durable, which is safe to use for kitchen food cooking, baking, and dry liquid ingredients measurement.
【 Never Fade Engraved Marking 】 Metal measure cups and spoons have markings on the outside. Engraved markings are stamped right into the metal. It will never fade and you can read the measurements.

【 Sturdy Handles 】 Stainless steel measuring cups have sturdy handles that will not bend or break. Superior craftsmanship, stackable measuring tablespoons and cups are designed with innovative round-shaped heads, the rounded bowls are easy to fill with dry and liquid ingredients, and the scoops easily fit most container openings.

【 Easy To Store and Dishwasher Safe 】 The kitchen measuring cups with two D-rings help keep cups and spoons together and stacked in one bundle. It allows you to store them in any drawer or cabinet and hang them up to save space. After you use them, you can throw them wash in the dishwasher for easy clean-up.

【 16 Sizes Measuring Cups, Spoons 】 20pcs set includes 7 cup measuring cups (1/16 cup, 1/4 cup, 1/3 cup, 1/2 cup, 2/3 cup, 3/4 cup, 1 cup), 9 tbsp measuring spoons (1/16 tsp,1/8 tsp, 1/4 tsp, 1/3 tsp,1/2 tsp, 3/4 tsp,1 tsp, 1/2 tsp, 1 tbsp), a magnetic conversion chart and a leveler spoon, meet all your needs on kitchen cooking food and baking.
